list_submissions: list all Prolific submissions or filter by study_id using the Submissions.list class method
retrieve_submission: retrieve a single Prolific submission by its id using the Submissions.retrieve class method
approve_submission: approve a Prolific submission by id using the Submissions.approve class method
reject_submission: reject a Prolific submission by id using the Submissions.reject class method with default rejection reason
change_submission_status: change a Prolific submission status via the internal _change_status method with action and optional rejection details
